First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Expect 19–21 mph on average: fast — for riders who race or train. It’s a drop ride: if you can’t hold the pace, you’ll finish alone. Fine if you know your speed. Not a first ride.
Check
Look at @metroatlantacyclingclub the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday Tango group ride

Thursday Tango is a road group ride in East Point, GA. It rolls every Thursday at 6:30 pm from Regions Bank.

A quick-pace Thursday training ride from MACC, 26 miles at 19 to 21 mph. The club files it as a drop ride, so it is not the one for a first group ride. Same start as the Tuesday Tap-Out.
